purpose: Teach: 漂っ/見当たら/神さま/ひまわり/ペットボトル/なぞ/吸う/はじまっ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 庭の方から、お線香の香り、漂ってきたな、お盆の季節だ。
lines.en: The scent of incense drifting from the garden… it's Obon season again.
lines.style: Soft opening, almost to himself. Eyes drift toward the garden. Slow, unhurried pacing. The voice of someone noticing time's pattern repeating.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。古い写真アルバム、最近、見当たらないのよね、どこにしまったかしら。
lines.en: Yes. Those old photo albums — I can't find them lately. I wonder where I put them.
lines.style: Slight worry beneath the surface. Searching tone, like she's mentally retracing her steps. Quieter, more inward than usual. Trailing question at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 神さまに、家族の幸せを、いつも願ってきたな、私たち。
lines.en: We've always prayed to the gods for our family's happiness, haven't we.
lines.style: Measured and knowing. A statement as much as reflection. Slight pause after 'gods.' Deep, unhurried delivery. Weight of decades in the cadence.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 庭のひまわり、孫が植えてくれたのよ、嬉しかったわ。
lines.en: Our grandchild planted that sunflower in the garden. I was so happy about it.
lines.style: Warm brightness breaks through. Slight lift in the voice on 'sunflower.' Fondness and pride without exaggeration. Eyes soft with the memory.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 最近、ペットボトルの水、毎日、買っているな、外出時。
lines.en: Lately I buy bottled water every time I go out, it seems.
lines.style: Gentle observation, slightly bemused at himself. Noticing a small habit without judgment. Quiet, wondering tone. Like he's seeing his own patterns for the first time.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 人生、まだまだ、なぞが多いわね、考えれば。
lines.en: When you really think about it, life still holds so many mysteries, doesn't it.
lines.style: Thoughtful and wondering. Voice travels inward. Slow pace, like she's settling into the thought. No hurry to conclude.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 禁煙してから、もう、タバコ、吸うこと、ないな、私。
lines.en: Since I quit smoking, I haven't had a cigarette. Not once.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Matter-of-fact, but with undertone of pride he won't emphasize. Steady delivery. The firmness of something survived.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 人生、振り返れば、結婚生活、ここからはじまったのよね、あなた。
lines.en: When I look back on my life, our marriage began right here, didn't it, dear.
lines.style: Tender and anchored. Voice reaches toward him slightly. The ease of long years speaking to each other. Gentle, certain. No doubt in her tone.
